app.description: App to attach or switch to: display name, package, bundle id, or the simulator name it runs on. Matches running apps and already-attached ones.

vmUri.description: VM service URI, e.g. ws://127.0.0.1:1234/abc=/ws. Omit to auto-discover the running app.

platform.description: ios | android. Omit to derive from the VM.

mode.description: flutter | device | auto (default). device = drive the sim with no Flutter app.

device.description: iOS simulator UDID or Android serial. Omit to auto-correlate to the app's real device. When nothing is running, passing a device from the "no app running" list starts its app there.

launch.description: Path to a Flutter project root to run when it is not in history. Usually you pass a device from the no-app-running list instead.

iosBridgePath.description: Path to compiled `glint-iossim` binary. iOS only.

returnScene.description: Include the first get_scene render. Default false.

dryRun.description: List attachable apps + devices without attaching. Default false.

awaitSettle.description: Wait until the UI settles before returning. Default false.

op.description: status (default) | appearance | openurl | screenshot | privacy | biometric

udid.description: Target simulator UDID. Defaults to the attached device.

inline.description: op=screenshot: also return the PNG as image content, so no separate read is needed. Default false.

latest.description: screenshot only: return the newest background capture (taken when the app left the foreground) instead of taking a new one. Default false.

action.description: privacy: grant | revoke | reset. biometric: enrol | unenrol | match | nomatch (match/nomatch answer a Face ID / Touch ID prompt that is showing).

device.description: Device id. Defaults to the attached device.
Device id. Defaults to the attached device.

all.description: Shut down every booted device. Default false.

glintId.description: Only this node and its descendants. Use to drill into one container or list instead of re-reading the whole screen.

depth.description: With glintId: levels below it to include (0 = the node only). Default: all, up to the renderer's cap.

x.description: Raw x coordinate (with y). Device mode: screenshot pixels; flutter mode: logical points. Bypasses glintId.

sequence.description: Several taps in one call, fired back to back: [{glintId}|{x,y}, …], up to 50. For PIN pads, OTP keypads, amounts, repeated backspace. glintIds resolve from one scene read before the first tap; changed is read once at the end.

intervalMs.description: Pause between sequence taps, 0-2000 ms. Default 120.

refuseNotHittable.description: When true, a non-hittable target produces an error (errorKind=notHittable) instead of a warning. Default false.

awaitReady.description: Arm the tap: block until the target is in the scene AND passes a hit test, then fire. Default false.

returnScene.description: After the tap, settle and return the new scene plus changed (bool) and changeCategory. Collapses tap → wait_for_settle → get_scene into one call. Default true.

detail.description: When true: include full geometry (painted, hittable, physicalCenter) in structuredContent. Default false (ok-only — saves tokens).

fetchScene.description: When true: include the full rendered scene text as postScene in structuredContent. Collapses returnScene + get_scene into one call. Default false.

awaitReady.description: Block until the target is in the scene and hittable, then fire.

returnScene.description: After the press, settle and return changed (bool) and changeCategory. Default true.

fetchScene.description: When true: also include the full rendered scene text as postScene. Default false.

fromGlintId.description: Start point — stable id from get_scene.

toGlintId.description: End point — stable id from get_scene.

awaitReady.description: Block until fromGlintId is in the scene and hittable, then fire.

returnScene.description: After the swipe, settle and return changed (bool) and changeCategory. Default true.

fetchScene.description: When true: also include the full rendered scene text as postScene. Default false.

fromGlintId.description: Start point — stable id from get_scene.

toGlintId.description: End point — stable id from get_scene.

awaitReady.description: Block until fromGlintId is in the scene and hittable, then fire.

returnScene.description: After the drag, settle and return changed (bool) and changeCategory. Default true.

fetchScene.description: When true: also include the full rendered scene text as postScene. Default false.

direction.description: One of: up, down, left, right

amountFraction.description: Fraction of viewport to travel (0.0–1.0). Default 0.6.

returnScene.description: After the scroll, settle and return changed (bool) and changeCategory. Default true.

fetchScene.description: When true: also include the full rendered scene text as postScene. Default false.

targetGlintId.description: Stable id to find. Mutually exclusive with `targetTextContent`.

targetTextContent.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against any text node's content. Useful when the compact renderer collapsed the id you wanted.

direction.description: One of: up, down, left, right. Default down.

keyDelayMs.description: Gap between keys, 0-1000 ms. Default 18. Raise it (e.g. 80) when a formatted field (phone, card, amount) drops characters.

clear.description: Empty the focused field before typing (select-all + backspace, then a per-char backspace fallback). Default false.

focus.description: Optional glintId of an input to tap before typing.

awaitReady.description: Only meaningful with `focus`: block until the focus target is hittable.

readyTimeoutMs.description: Ceiling for `awaitReady` on the focus field. Default 5000.

returnScene.description: After typing, settle and return the new scene plus changed (bool) and changeCategory. Default true.

detail.description: When true: include full geometry in structuredContent. Default false.

fetchScene.description: When true: include the full rendered scene text as postScene. Default false.

key.description: One of: backspace, delete, enter, tab, escape, space, up, down, left, right.

modifiers.description: Held around the key: cmd, shift, ctrl, alt.

returnScene.description: Read the post-press scene for changed. Default true.

button.description: Button name. One of: home, back, lock, unlock, volumeUp, volumeDown, appSwitcher.

ceilingMs.description: Hard cap on wait time. Default 5000.

quietFrames.description: Consecutive quiet polls required to declare settled. Default 3.

checkLoadingAffordances.description: When true, frame-quiet still polls if any CircularProgressIndicator / LinearProgressIndicator / RefreshIndicator is in the scene. Default true.

steps.description: Ordered steps, each {tool: "<name>", args: {…}} with the same args the tool takes on its own. Max 20.

stopOnNoChange.description: Stop when a step reports changed:false. Default true.

returnScene.description: Append the final scene text. Default true.

steps.description: Optional steps to run while recording. Max 20.

durationMs.description: Passive capture with no steps, or the tail after them (0-30000). Default 400.

distinctOnly.description: Keep only frames that differ. Default true.

failuresOnly.description: Only entries that failed (had an errorKind).

errorsOnly.description: Only entries that look like exceptions / stack traces.

format.description: text (default, rendered) or json (structured entries — pass this to get the entries array).

op.description: status (default) | open | close | note | list | export

sessionId.description: Target session (optional for export; defaults to active).

key.description: Config key to set, e.g. scrollMaxScrolls (required for set; `get` lists all keys + current values).

value.description: New value for `key` (required for set). Type matches the key: int (scrollMaxScrolls), double (scrollAmountFraction), or bool.

body.description: What happened, what you expected, repro steps. Redacted before submission.

includeContext.description: Attach the recent action log (tools, targets, outcomes). Default false.

dryRun.description: Compose and return the redacted issue without filing. Use it to show the user exactly what would be posted.

op.description: status (default) | report | ship | dryRun | token_usage | audit_show | audit_verify

limit.description: For audit_show / token_usage / report: max entries to return (default 20 / 10 / 15).

sinceId.description: For token_usage / report: only count events with id > sinceId (default 0 = everything recorded).
